name: audio-player
title: Audio Player
description: The parts of a sound player around an `<audio>` element: play, a waveform that is also the time bar, time, speed and mute.

meta.when: A voice note, a recording, a clip of music or narration a person plays and seeks in. The project gives the element its source and, for the waveform, the peaks (computed ahead of time, or with computePeaks for a short clip); without peaks the bar is a flat line of the same size. Offer a Transcript (from captions) for anything spoken. Nothing plays by itself. For video use video-player; for a plain time bar without a waveform use scrubber.
meta.example:
<AudioPlayer aria-label="Voice note from Ana">
  <AudioPlayerAudio src="/note.mp3" />
  <AudioPlayerPlay />
  <AudioPlayerWaveform peaks={peaks} />
  <AudioPlayerTime />
  <AudioPlayerRate />
  <AudioPlayerMute />
</AudioPlayer>

// Peaks for a short clip, in the browser
const peaks = await computePeaks(await (await fetch("/note.mp3")).arrayBuffer(), 64);
